text: Implemented sparse Relation with identity, composition, converse, union, subset, image, erosion, defensive rows, and validated reflexive/symmetric evidence. Added VertexLocus to reuse VertexBasis and explicit directed/undirected graph adapters with payload filters/rebuilders and Reject/Drop loop policy. JVM+JS: locus 28 passed each; graph 40 passed each; dense Boolean differential and relation laws green.
